摆臂停在 90° 后，1.7 s 主站发“停”：固件停住、抱闸，抱住后关输出、回: With the arm at 90°, the master sends “Stop” at 1.7 s: the firmware stops, engages the brake, switches off once braked and returns to ready — the arm does not fall (the round 102 firmware switched off immediately on “Stop”).

The master's “Stop” at 1.75 s is not executed during the fault.
摆臂停在 90° 后，1.7 s 抱闸线圈短路：电流冲上去 → 报故障 7（过流: With the arm at 90°, the brake coil shorts at 1.7 s: the current shoots up → fault 7 (overcurrent), the brake drive is removed to protect the switch; the motor holds in place first and switches off only when the coil current has dropped (brake holding) — the arm does not fall.
摆臂停在 90° 后，1.7 s 输出端编码器线断：故障 5 立即关输出、同时抱: With the arm at 90°, the output encoder wire breaks at 1.7 s: fault 5 switches the output off at once and engages the brake. The coil current takes tens of milliseconds to fall to the release level, so the arm drops a little before it is held.
摆臂停在 90°（水平）后，1.6 s 起主站不再发指令：约 100 ms 后报: With the arm at 90° (horizontal), the master stops sending commands from 1.6 s: about 100 ms later a communication timeout is reported, and the firmware decelerates, stops and holds position powered, so the arm does not fall; at 2.6 s the bus drops to 30 V: it can no longer hold, so it stops, engages the brake and switches off once braked — the arm does not fall (the round 107 board had no brake and the arm fell to 75° here; round 110 added the brake).
摆臂停在 90°（水平）后，1.9 s 时末端突然多挂 0.5 kg（输出端多: With the arm held at 90° (horizontal), 0.5 kg is suddenly hung on the tip at 1.9 s (1.47 N·m more at the output); see how far the position deviates, how fast it recovers and how much the current rises.
摆臂停在 90°（水平，重力矩最大）后，1.7 s 母线掉到 30 V：报欠压，: With the arm at 90° (horizontal, max gravity torque), the bus drops to 30 V at 1.7 s: undervoltage is reported, it stops, engages the brake and switches off only once braked — the arm does not fall.
摆臂在 60°（有重力），抱闸线圈的线断了。上电对零时松闸，测不到线圈电流 →: The arm is at 60° (under gravity) and the brake coil wire is broken. When releasing for zeroing at power-up no coil current is measured → fault 7 (open wire), output off; the brake spring is still holding, so the arm does not move. The master's command at 0.45 s is not executed either (the round 110 firmware could not detect this and would drive against the brake).

0x201 指令（主站 → 驱动板）：[0] 模式 0 停、1 速度、2 位置、: 0x201 command (master → driver board): [0] mode 0 stop, 1 speed, 2 position, 3 clear fault, [1..4] target (int32)

更换洁净间风机过滤单元、测粒子计数，码盘重新清洗: Replace the clean room fan filter units, measure particle counts, reclean the discs
测固化炉炉温曲线、校温控，没固化透的传感器补固化: Profile the curing oven, calibrate temperature control, post-cure sensors not fully cured
重做精度补偿表（把整圈误差补平）: Redo the accuracy compensation table (flatten the full-turn error)
修复混砂机在线水分控制、和型砂实验室比对校准，型砂含水回到 3.0–3.8 %: Repair the sand mixer's inline moisture control, calibrate against the sand lab; sand moisture back to 3.0–3.8 %
孕育剂换新并烘干、密封保存，孕育后 8 min 内浇完: Use fresh inoculant, dried and sealed; pour within 8 min of inoculation
更换 3 号卧加精镗夹具的两个定位销和衬套，首件上三坐标确认: Replace the two locating pins and bushings of the No. 3 HMC finish-boring fixture; check the first part on the CMM
校准时效炉热电偶、测炉温均匀性，按工艺炉温重新时效: Calibrate the aging furnace thermocouples, measure temperature uniformity, re-age at the process temperature
更换高频淬火感应器，调整加热参数，首件剖检硬化层: Replace the induction hardening coil, adjust heating parameters, section the first part to check case depth
放宽机壳和轴的检验公差（不对症：问题还在，只是不报）: Widen the housing and shaft inspection tolerances (not addressing the cause: the problem remains, just not reported)
三坐标改成全检（不对症：只是查得更多，不能消除原因）: Change the CMM to 100% inspection (not addressing the cause: just checks more, cannot remove the cause)
超差机壳返镗（不对症：返镗只救这一件，后面的照样超差）: Re-bore out-of-tolerance housings (not addressing the cause: re-boring saves only this part, later ones are still out)
更换磁钢粘贴定位工装，用标准转子复核磁钢位置: Replace the magnet bonding positioning fixture; recheck magnet positions with a reference rotor
检修充磁机（换储能电容、校充磁电压），已充的转子复充磁: Service the magnetizer (replace storage capacitors, calibrate magnetizing voltage); remagnetize rotors already done
检修绕线机 wd-2 张力器、校张力，复测这台绕的定子: Service the tensioner on winding machine wd-2, calibrate tension, retest stators it wound
测浸漆烘箱炉温曲线、换加热管、校温控，没固化透的定子按正常炉温补烘: Profile the varnish oven, replace heaters, calibrate temperature control; re-bake under-cured stators at normal temperature
在驱动器参数里补偿齿槽转矩: Compensate cogging torque in the drive parameters
定子按原炉温再烘一遍: Bake the stators again at the original temperature
关节装配工位 JA-2 预紧扭矩偏低（这个工位装的关节背隙偏大）: Low preload torque at joint assembly station JA-2 (joints assembled there have high backlash)
谐波减速器来料批次背隙偏大（从注入时的批次起）: High backlash in an incoming lot of harmonic reducers (from the lot at injection)
关节测试台零位标定程序漂移（零位残差逐台偏移）: Joint test stand zero calibration program drifting (zero residual shifting unit by unit)
关节装配工位 JA-1 编码器定位工装磨损（这个工位装的关节输出端编码器偏心，双: Worn encoder positioning fixture at joint assembly station JA-1 (joints assembled there have an eccentric output encoder and a large dual-encoder cross-check difference)
关节测试台抱闸扭矩传感器漂移（保持力矩读数一台比一台低，抱闸其实是好的）: Joint test stand brake torque sensor drifting (holding torque reads lower unit after unit; the brakes are actually fine)
钢网堵孔（锡膏体积逐块下降、少锡）: Stencil apertures clogging (solder paste volume falling board by board, insufficient solder)
回流炉温漂（峰值温度逐渐下降、冷焊风险）: Reflow oven temperature drift (peak temperature gradually falling, cold joint risk)
多功能贴片机 PP-2 吸嘴磨损（只有它贴的 IC 偏移变大）: Worn nozzles on multi-function placer PP-2 (only ICs it places drift more)
采样电阻来料批次阻值偏大（从注入时的那一卷起）: High resistance in an incoming lot of sense resistors (from the reel at injection)
探针卡磨损（第 6 个测试位接触电阻逐片升高、误判开路）: Probe card wear (contact resistance at test site 6 rising wafer by wafer, false opens)
划片刀磨损（崩边逐批增大）: Dicing blade wear (chipping growing lot by lot)
键合机 wb-2 劈刀磨损（只有它键合的批次拉力下降）: Capillary wear on wire bonder wb-2 (pull strength falling only on lots it bonds)
粘接对心机 cb-2 对心夹具磨损（只有它粘的码盘偏心变大）: Centering fixture wear on bonding and centering machine cb-2 (only discs it bonds get more eccentric)
读头装调台间隙塞规磨损（间隙偏大、信号幅值下降）: Read-head gap feeler gauge worn (gap too large, signal amplitude falling)
洁净间过滤器堵塞（码盘落污点）: Clean room filter clogged (contamination on discs)
应变胶固化炉温度偏低（扭矩传感器蠕变、滞后变大）: Strain gauge adhesive curing oven too cool (torque sensor creep and hysteresis increase)
磁钢粘贴台定位工装磨损（磁钢贴歪、齿槽转矩变大）: Magnet bonding fixture worn (magnets misaligned, cogging torque increases)
充磁机电容老化、充磁电压偏低（反电势常数下降）: Magnetizer capacitors aged, magnetizing voltage low (back-EMF constant falls)
绕线机 wd-2 张力不稳（只有它绕的定子三相电阻不平衡）: Unstable tension on winding machine wd-2 (only stators it winds have unbalanced phase resistance)
浸漆烘箱炉温偏低（绝缘漆没固化透、耐压漏电流变大）: Varnish oven too cool (insulation varnish not fully cured, hipot leakage increases)
混砂机加水控制失灵、型砂含水偏高（铸件气孔）: Sand mixer water control failed, sand moisture high (casting gas porosity)
孕育剂受潮、孕育衰退（铸件硬度偏高、加工崩刀）: Damp inoculant, inoculation fade (castings too hard, tool chipping in machining)
3 号卧加精镗夹具定位销磨损（只有它镗的平缝机壳针杆孔位置度、中心距漂移）: Worn locating pins on the No. 3 HMC finish-boring fixture (needle bar hole position and center distance drift only on housings it bores)
时效炉热电偶漂移、实际炉温偏低（残余应力没去掉，机壳同轴度、平面度变差）: Aging furnace thermocouple drift, actual temperature low (residual stress not relieved, housing coaxiality and flatness worsen)
高频淬火感应器老化、加热不足（轴颈硬度偏低）: Induction hardening coil aged, insufficient heating (journal hardness low)
一张急单串起七个领域: One rush order through seven domains
海港起重的新港口起重机项目追加 20 台 WQR-105 减速器，12 天交货。: Harbor Cranes' new port crane project adds 20 WQR-105 reducers due in 12 days. Sales takes the order; the planner runs MRP and releases it to the shop.
订单经平台写进 ERPNext：销售订单、输出轴工单、请购单，都是真单据。: The order is written to ERPNext through the platform: sales order, output shaft work order and material request, all real documents.
算料一眼看出：这 20 台要 40 个轴承 BRG-6207，库里只有 8 个。: MRP shows at a glance: these 20 units need 40 BRG-6207 bearings, and only 8 are in stock.
输出轴工单马上下达车间，七道工序开始排队。: The output shaft work order is released to the shop at once, and seven operations start queuing.
这张订单是两周的主线，后面每一幕花的钱、拖的时间，最后都落在它的毛利和回款上。: This order is the thread of the two weeks: the money spent and time lost in every later scene end up in its margin and payment.
轴承 BRG-6207 只剩 8 个，这张单要 40 个。采购向常用的五大湖轴承: Only 8 BRG-6207 bearings left; this order needs 40. Purchasing orders from the usual supplier Great Lakes Bearings, 7 days to arrive — tighter than the due date.
厂情中枢报“缺料”，因果链：轴承 → 要用它的订单 → 客户。: The Plant Insight Hub reports “shortage”; causal chain: bearing → orders that use it → customer.
右栏比较“紧急采购 / 等常规到货”：加急要多花钱，不加急要晚交。: The right panel compares “urgent purchase / wait for normal delivery”: expediting costs money, not expediting delivers late.
采纳的加急费用，会记到这张订单的毛利上。: The expedite fee adopted is charged to this order's margin.
采购单发出去了；它到货时会出事（第 3 幕）。: The purchase order is out; when it arrives there will be trouble (scene 3).
五大湖轴承的这一批到了。来料检验抽 8 件，内径超差两件——整批判不合格，进不了: The Great Lakes Bearings lot has arrived. Incoming inspection samples 8 pieces, two with bore out of tolerance — the whole lot is rejected and cannot go into stock.
ERPNext 里有检验单（不合格）和收货单草稿，账和实物对得上。: ERPNext has the inspection record (rejected) and a draft receipt; books and goods match.
四个方案：退货等补发 / 备选供应商急单 / 让步接收全检 / 不处理；推演算出: Four options: return and wait for reshipment / rush order with the alternative supplier / concession with 100% inspection / do nothing; the what-if shows when material arrives and the extra cost of each.
一个供应商出问题，钱和交期一起受影响。: When one supplier has a problem, both money and due date suffer.
换供应商的加价、全检的工时，同样记到这张订单上。: The alternative supplier's markup and the inspection hours are also charged to this order.
磨床的熟练工下个班请假两天，这一班没人会开外圆磨床——而这张单的 20 根输出轴: The skilled grinder operator is on leave for two days from the next shift; nobody on that shift can run the cylindrical grinder — and all 20 output shafts of this order go through the grinder.
技能矩阵一眼看出：会开磨床的只有两三个人，这是“单点依赖”。: The skills matrix shows at a glance: only two or three people can run the grinder; this is a “single-point dependency”.
方案：调班 / 加班 / 借调；推演算出每个方案对交期的影响。: Options: shift swap / overtime / borrow staff; the what-if shows each option's effect on the due date.
加班费记到这张订单的“急单、加班、外协”里。: Overtime pay is charged to this order's “rush, overtime, subcontract”.
人手紧了就容易赶工——下一幕的安全隐患就是这么来的。: When staff is tight people rush — that is how the next scene's safety hazard arises.
为了赶产量，有人把磨床的防护门联锁短接了。巡检发现，报了重大隐患。: To push output, someone bypassed the grinder's guard door interlock. An inspection found it and reported a major hazard.
重大隐患没有“不处理”这个选项：要么马上停机整改，要么等这一件做完再停。: A major hazard has no “do nothing” option: either stop and fix now, or stop once this part is finished.
推演给出停机多久、哪张订单要晚几小时。: The what-if gives how long the stop is and which order is how many hours late.
安全和交期打架时，平台把代价摆出来，但不替人做这个决定。: When safety and delivery conflict, the platform shows the cost but does not make the decision for people.
停机整改又吃掉磨床的时间；磨床本身也该保养了（第 6 幕）。: The lockout eats grinder time again; and the grinder itself is due for PM (scene 6).
外圆磨床连着加班，运行小时已经超过保养周期，坏掉的概率在往上走。: The cylindrical grinder has run overtime back to back; its run hours are past the PM interval and the probability of failure is rising.
方案：现在停下来保养 / 这张单做完再保养；推演按故障概率算两种做法的期望损失。: Options: stop for PM now / PM after this order; the what-if computes the expected loss of each by failure probability.
ERPNext 里生成维护单，保养完运行小时清零。: A maintenance order is created in ERPNext; run hours reset after PM.
这是“现在花小钱”还是“赌一把”的经典取舍。: This is the classic trade-off of “spend a little now” versus “take a gamble”.
设备一停一开、加班到夜里，就有了空转（第 7 幕）。: With machines stopping and starting and overtime into the night, idling appears (scene 7).
带锯床早早下完了这张单的料，却一直开着没关，夜里也空转；热处理炉又排在了电价最贵: The band saw finished cutting the material for this order early but stayed on, idling through the night; and the heat-treat furnace was loaded in the most expensive peak hours.
电表每 15 分钟一条读数，空转电量一目了然。: Meters give a reading every 15 minutes, so idle energy is plain to see.
方案：自动待机（10 分钟 / 30 分钟）/ 全厂待机；推演算出省多少度电、多: Options: auto standby (10 / 30 minutes) / plant-wide standby; the what-if computes the kWh, money and carbon saved.
订单在做期间，加工过它的设备（带锯床、车床、磨床……）的空转电按件数分摊到这张订: While the order was in progress, the idle energy of the machines that worked on it (band saw, lathes, grinder…) is allocated to this order's margin by part count.
车间做完这张单，就该交货开票了（第 8 幕）。: Once the shop finishes this order, it is time to deliver and invoice (scene 8).
20 根输出轴做完，订单交付、ERPNext 开出销售发票。可海港起重付款一向慢: The 20 output shafts are done, the order delivered and the ERPNext sales invoice issued. But Harbor Cranes always pays late, and the invoice is past due unpaid.
发票是这张订单的，不是另造的一笔：从下单到回款是一条线。: The invoice belongs to this order, not a made-up one: from order to payment is one thread.
方案：发催款函 / 信用冻结 / 不处理；看未来 8 周现金哪周最紧。: Options: send a reminder / credit hold / do nothing; see which of the next 8 weeks is tightest for cash.
毛利是“赚不赚钱”，回款是“有没有钱”。: Margin is “do we make money”; collection is “do we have money”.
最后复盘：这张订单的毛利里，能看到前面每一幕花的钱。: Final review: this order's margin shows the money spent in every earlier scene.
严重程度只能是 info / warn / critical: Severity can only be info / warn / critical
L10 是 90% 可靠度的寿命，不是“到期必坏”；但越往后坏的概率越大，计划停: L10 is the life at 90% reliability, not “sure to fail when due”; but the later it gets the higher the chance of failure, and replacing at a planned stop is much cheaper than after a failure.
Miner 累积损伤到 1 即预计出现疲劳裂纹。: When Miner's cumulative damage reaches 1, a fatigue crack is expected.
检查键槽附近有无裂纹（磁粉探伤）；把现场载荷谱送设计台复核: Check for cracks near the keyway (magnetic particle test); send the field load spectrum to the design desk for review
油老化后黏度下降、酸值升高，齿面和轴承磨损加快。: Aged oil loses viscosity and gains acidity, and gear flank and bearing wear speed up.
尽快换油（L-CKC 220），并取油样化验: Change the oil soon (L-CKC 220) and take an oil sample for analysis
振动也在上升：多半是轴承损坏、摩擦发热，先处理轴承。: Vibration is rising too: most likely bearing damage and friction heat; deal with the bearing first.
工况（转矩、环境温度）都算进模型了，实测还是高很多，说明散热系数变小了：风扇坏、: Load (torque, ambient temperature) is all in the model, yet the measurement is much higher, so the cooling coefficient has dropped: fan broken, housing surface covered in dust / sludge, ventilation blocked, or low oil (churning, poorer lubrication).
检查风扇、清理箱体表面和散热筋、检查油位: Check the fan, clean the housing surface and fins, check the oil level
开维修单：清洁散热、检查风扇和油位: Open a repair order: clean cooling, check fan and oil level
最高油温超过 90 ℃（工况造成，不是故障）: Maximum oil temperature above 90 °C (caused by load, not a fault)
油温 = 环境 + 发热 ÷（散热系数 × 面积），重载、夏天户外都会让油温升高: Oil temperature = ambient + heat ÷ (cooling coefficient × area); heavy load and outdoor summer both raise oil temperature.
轴端加风扇（散热系数 17 → 31）或降载；油温高也会让换油提前: Add a fan on the shaft end (cooling coefficient 17 → 31) or reduce load; high oil temperature also brings the oil change forward
Bearing life shortens with the cube of load: 30% higher mean torque leaves only about half the bearing life (1/1.3³ ≈ 0.46); shocks mainly consume the output shaft's fatigue life.
皮带上料过多、卡料，或者选型时低估了负载。: Belt overfed, jams, or the load was underestimated at selection.
和客户核对给料量、加过载保护（液力耦合器 / 转矩限制器）；长期如此要换大一号的: Check the feed rate with the customer, add overload protection (fluid coupling / torque limiter); if it persists, use a size larger reducer — the data can go to the design desk
开维修单：换油: Open a repair order: oil change
安排下次停机时换油: Change oil at the next stop
一到两周内更换: Replace within one to two weeks
已经超过 L10（10% 的同型轴承会在此前损坏）: Already past L10 (10% of identical bearings fail before this)
散热变差（风扇坏 / 表面积灰）：散热系数在 2 天内降到 70%: Poorer cooling (fan broken / dusty surface): cooling coefficient drops to 70% within 2 days
轴承早期损坏（中间轴轴承 B）：振动按指数上升，约 25 天进入 D 区，油温略: Early bearing damage (intermediate shaft bearing B): vibration rises exponentially, zone D in about 25 days, oil temperature slightly up
过载：皮带上料过多，平均转矩 ×1.3，卡料增多: Overload: belt overfed, mean torque ×1.3, more jams
轻载、室内恒温、变频 80%: Light load, climate-controlled indoors, VFD at 80%
这台设备上没有该工序的派工: No dispatch for this operation on this machine
设备正常，无需复位: Machine is fine, no reset needed
生产模式不接受故障注入: Fault injection not accepted in production mode
缩短比例应在 0–1 之间: Reduction ratio must be between 0 and 1
未知工单，派工时需附工艺路线: Unknown work order; dispatch needs the routing
情景开始前已在用（示例）: In use before the scenario started (sample)
写一句投诉的现象，例如“J2 异响、定位不准”: Write one sentence on the symptom, e.g. “J2 noise, positioning off”
填客户，或填机器人序列号（会自动带出客户）: Enter the customer, or the robot serial number (fills in the customer)
建议 A：同一批磨得快，没报警的迟早也会到上限；一次排工比一台台被投诉划算: Suggest A: the same lot wears fast; those without alarms will hit the limit sooner or later; one dispatch beats being complained to unit by unit
撞过一次重的：定位精度下降，建议远程重新标定: Had one heavy crash: positioning accuracy dropped; suggest remote recalibration
其余同批的等报警了再说（会陆续出问题）: Leave the rest of the lot until they alarm (they will fail one by one)
客户会陆续投诉: Customers will complain one after another
不对症时只是花钱: If it does not address the cause it just costs money
种类（动火 / 高处 / 受限空间 / 挂牌上锁）: Type (hot work / height / confined space / lockout)
最近 last 片晶圆的 CP 良率均值比之前 base 片低 drop 个百分: Mean CP yield of the last last wafers is more than drop percentage points below the previous base wafers
先看晶圆图：散点成簇是工艺缺陷（找代工厂），某个测试位规律地红是探针卡（清洁、量: Look at the wafer map first: clustered spots are process defects (go to the foundry), a test site regularly red is the probe card (clean, measure contact resistance), a ring at the edge is IDDQ
最近 last 片晶圆里，某个测试位的平均失效率是其余测试位中位数的 facto: In the last last wafers, one test site's average failure rate is more than factor times the median of the other sites and not below floor %
芯片不会按测试位坏——这是测试的问题：清洁探针、量各测试位接触电阻，超寿命的探针: Chips do not fail by test site — this is a test problem: clean the probes, measure each site's contact resistance, replace probe cards past their life; misjudged wafers can be retested to recover good chips
最近 last 批成品的键合拉力（抽检最小值）按键合机分开：某台均值低于 bel: Bond pull strength of the last last finished lots (sample minimum) split by wire bonder: one bonder's mean below below gf, or more than gap gf below the other
只有一台低就查那台的劈刀寿命和超声参数；两台一起低查金线批次和框架镀银: If only one is low, check that bonder's capillary life and ultrasonic parameters; if both are low, check the gold wire lot and frame silver plating
最近 last 批成品的塑封空洞率均值超过 above %: Mean molding void rate of the last last finished lots above above %
塑封料是否受潮（回温时间、开封后用了多久），模具排气槽是否堵: Is the molding compound damp (thaw time, time since opening), are the mold vents clogged
最近 last 批成品的划片崩边（抽检最大值）均值超过 above µm（上限: Mean dicing chipping of the last last finished lots (sample maximum) above above µm (limit 25 µm)
查划片刀已切米数、修刀记录；崩边大的芯片可靠性差: Check the dicing blade's cut length and dressing record; chips with large chipping are less reliable
